intermediate.name: Zongkalaize Scenic Area
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (HC) Zongkalaize Scenic Area (136.7 km)

story: The fourth stage of the Tour of Magnificent Qinghai 2026 started very fast, with a break forming after 35 km. Teammates Sinschek and Tsishkou led the break, but Sinschek did most of the work and eventually dropped Tsishkou on the major climb. Astana led the peloton and caught Sinschek near the climb's end. Castellon attacked on the climb and was joined by Umba; they cooperated effectively. Behind them, poor cooperation allowed Buchmann to bridge to the lead group. In the final sprint among three riders, Umba secured the victory ahead of Castellon.
